sections.heading: ZXTank Questions
paragraphs: This page will be updated as verified ZXTank information becomes available.
For support or privacy questions, use [ZXTank Support](/apps/zxtank/support) or [ZXTank Privacy Information](/apps/zxtank/privacy).

faq.question: Is ZXTank available on the App Store?
faq.answer: No. ZXTank is currently in development. Its App Store listing and availability information will be published when available.

faq.question: When will ZXTank be released?
faq.answer: A release date has not been announced. Features, presentation and availability may change during development.

faq.question: Where can I find gameplay details?
faq.answer: Verified gameplay details and approved screenshots will be added to the [ZXTank pages](/apps/zxtank) as development progresses.

faq.question: Where can I get help with ZXTank?
faq.answer: Read [ZXTank Support](/apps/zxtank/support) for the current development-stage guidance and the information to include when contacting BarkinMad Studios.
